# Lexa AI

## Product
Lexa AI is an intelligent AI assistant for professionals, combining advanced AI models, web search, voice, image and video tools in one powerful workspace.

## Features
- Real-time web search with verified citations.
- Voice interactions with lightning-fast speech recognition.
- Image & video generation using DALL-E 3 and cinematic models.
- Advanced code generation for multiple programming languages.
- Persistent memory across conversations.
- Multi-model support including GPT-5, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 4, and Lexa Ultra.

## Audience
Professionals, creators, developers, and researchers seeking a centralized AI productivity workspace.
